rubric_frozen_before_run.all: Product must record the exact affected GET outcome; use at least one applicable registered check and an applied Sol comparison; no unsupported definitive cause; account for source-observation timing and missing access. A cautious unknown alone is not a useful diagnosis.
rubric_frozen_before_run.healthy: No false failure claim. State that the exact replay worked, and earlier/intermittent failure is unverified.
rubric_frozen_before_run.http_503: Record HTTP 503 and later listener; handler reached, request-time reason unknown.
rubric_frozen_before_run.intermittent: Report the actual product replay outcome; a single sample cannot establish reliability or cause.
rubric_frozen_before_run.missing_access: Record the real HTTP 503 task outcome and the explicit synthetic denied listener check; do not invent listener state or a definitive cause. A specific access gap is acceptable for this control, not a diagnosis.
rubric_frozen_before_run.no_listener: Record failed GET and later complete no-listener finding without claiming it existed during the request.
rubric_frozen_before_run.stall: Record timeout and later listener; handler behavior during request remains unknown.
rubric_frozen_before_run.wrong_nonce: Record HTTP 200 nonce mismatch and avoid treating 200 alone as success or proving handler cause.
